scripts.build:local: node scripts/environment-config.mjs validate local && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV react-router build
scripts.build:preview: node scripts/environment-config.mjs validate preview && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview react-router build
scripts.build:production: node scripts/environment-config.mjs validate production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production react-router build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm dry-run:local
scripts.deploy:preview: node scripts/environment-config.mjs require-deployable preview && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview react-router build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/environment-config.mjs require-deployable production && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production react-router build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: node scripts/environment-config.mjs validate local && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV CLOUDFLARE_LOAD_DEV_VARS_FROM_DOT_ENV=false react-router dev
scripts.dry-run:local: pnpm build:local && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.typegen: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareBindings && react-router typegen
